videos.headline: Brock Purdy throws dime to George Kittle for opening-drive TD
Christian McCaffrey crosses the goal line for the 49ers
Terry McLaurin carted off field with apparent knee injury
Jayden Daniels inexplicably throws ball away on 4th down
Christian McCaffrey gets into the end zone for the 2nd time
Jayden Daniels slings TD pass to Stefon Diggs for the Commanders
Commanders pull closer as White reels in TD from Daniels
